name: Futami Shion
source: A librarian and an old friend of [url=/c67798]Yue[/url] and [url=/c66131]Shin[/url]. After recently returning to Japan from England, she works as a part-timer at "YuKuRu." Graceful and serene, with a peculiar sense for brewing tea, her presence makes the café more calming and elegant. She feels a strong affinity with [url=/c64617]Kagamigawa Noel[/url].
